title: Alder Sluice
description: A late melody crosses a repeating lower figure whose dotted notes resist the bar accents. G, E-flat and C remain the three familiar places while the melody grows into longer ribbons. The original late entry returns, followed by a seven-bar descent to a bare fifth.
technical_note: Keep the three dotted eighths light and equal within the lower pattern; avoid accenting its restart. The right hand grows from isolated phrases into eight-note lines. Leave the shared breaths completely clear of pedal.

performance.note: Authored phrase breathing and independent note lengths; no random timing offsets.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
